goals.description: Deliver a reproducible export with independent review.

open_work.title: Export requirement 0
open_work.description: The export must retain stable identifiers and produce deterministic ordering when multiple rows share a timestamp. An operator should be able to select the date range explicitly. Empty input is a successful empty export, with a header and no invented rows.

assessment.verification_context: The report should distinguish a missing source from an empty source. A failed source query must expose its error through the existing status response and must not publish an apparently successful artifact. Existing authorization and review rules continue to apply.
